gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline is a sans-serif with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, friendly and open. Mozilla Headline sits under Bushcraft, whose bent-tubing letters are closed, widely spaced and artistic.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-mozilla-text: Chunky and open, Mozilla Text has lowercase bodies so large they look bold, with terminals that flare outward. But Bushcraft draws its bowls and stems alike, closed and widely spaced, happiest on a single big line.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-nobile: Nobile reads crisp and contemporary, its capitals nearly level with the lowercase and its letter mouths left open like unjoined chalk arcs. Bushcraft brings the bent-tubing flair; Nobile does the quiet talking.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-nokora: Bushcraft is all bent tubing, closed and widely spaced. Nokora has a wide-open s and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase, which gives running text a sturdy, inviting feel.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans: Bushcraft draws bent-tubing letters with no shift in weight, closed and widely spaced, expressive in a way that wants room. Noto Sans opens its lowercase wide, giving the eye somewhere to rest.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Bushcraft never thins a curve, so each bent-tube letter keeps one gauge, and the spacing between characters runs extra wide. Noto Sans Adlam supplies the openness: full curves, endings kept apart.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Bushcraft draws every curve at a steady weight, closed and widely spaced, with capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. Noto Sans Arabic then adds wide openings and a pronounced x-height for the body.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-armeni: Noto Sans Armenian is a professional, approachable sans with full-bodied c, s and z and wide, inviting openings on round letters. Closed Bushcraft against open Armenian letters is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-avesta: Noto Sans Avestan reads modern and clean, its curve tips held apart and its x-height pronounced. Bushcraft, closed and widely spaced like bent tubing, supplies the display-sized flourish while the body stays open.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-bengal: Expressive from the first glance, Bushcraft draws closed letters with extra-wide spacing and capitals that hardly stand out. Noto Sans Bengali supplies distinctly open letter mouths, and that closed-versus-open tension carries the pair.
